ZOOM_ACCOUNT_ID.description: One of the three values a server-to-server app presents. Zoom states no sensitivity for any of them, which is why all three are secret here.

ZOOM_CLIENT_ID.description: The second. Zoom calls these app credentials without dividing them.

ZOOM_CLIENT_SECRET.description: The third. Zoom never says to keep it private, which is almost certainly an omission rather than a position, but this registry records what a provider states. Regenerating replaces the value in place.
